title: IVG Savr 3000 Pro Blue Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Pro Blue IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pods offer a rich, fruity mix of ripe Blueberry and tangy Raspberry with a streak of ice for a cool, clean exhale. It’s a familiar all-day vape with an uplifting, refreshing edge. The refill system combines a prefilled 2ml pod with a 4ml refill container, giving up to 3000 puffs per kit. Once clicked together and slotted into the IVG Savr 3000 device, the refill automatically tops up the pod, eliminating the need for refills or coil swaps. Mesh coil tech ensures strong flavour from start to finish, ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vapers. How to Set Up IVG Savr Prefilled Pod's Step 1: Unpack the Device Remove the cap from the mouthpiece. Take out the silicone stopper from the pod. Step 2: Prepare the Refill Peel off the red sticker. Remove the rubber stop. Step 3: Connect the Pod Align the refill with the pod. Press until you hear a click. Step 4: Insert into Device Slide the full pod-and-refill unit into the Savr device. Step 5: Prime the Coil Wait a few minutes to let the coil fully saturate. ✅ Ready to Vape! Inhale to activate and enjoy.
